what: the R61 emulator runner initially did NOT reset numpy-path policies (base/c1 FlatPolicy) between episodes; stale perception state produced 60-frame flap-spam deaths (0 pipes) on later episodes of a shard
detected: base r58_dir2p_true showed 16/30 seeds at 0 pipes with identical 60-frame/60-flap rows — mechanically impossible for a policy that flies 87-alive on family seeds
fix: run_episode now calls policy.reset_obs() at every episode start for numpy-path policies (deploy-path perception was always fresh per episode)
recovery: all base (30) and c1 (30) episodes re-run with the fixed runner; the 60 deploy episodes were unaffected (fresh perception per episode) and kept; the archived contaminated rows are retained locally (gitignored) for audit
deploy_rows_unchanged_evidence: the deploy path re-creates perception per episode and reproduced all 7 family seeds byte-exactly; its rows contain no sub-400-frame episode
